name: Orbit Family
subtitle: Особистий сімейний AI-помічник
description: Офіційне приватне джерело оновлень Orbit для родини Minkovskyi.

apps.name: Orbit
apps.subtitle: Голосовий сімейний AI-помічник
apps.localizedDescription: Orbit — приватний сімейний AI-помічник для чату, голосу, родинних профілів, повідомлень і календаря.

versions.localizedDescription: Main Orbit не активує аудіосесію, доки ви самі не запустите голосову розмову.

apps.name: Orbit CallKit
apps.subtitle: System voice call for Siri and the lock screen
apps.localizedDescription: A separate strict CallKit edition of Orbit. Siri starts it in the background, it uses the native iPhone call lifecycle, and it never falls back to the full-screen direct connection.

versions.localizedDescription: Siri and Shortcuts now launch Orbit through the iOS background audio process. The installed app name is Orbit, enabling the commands Start Orbit and Stop Orbit.

apps.name: Orbit Voice
apps.subtitle: Окремий голосовий клієнт Orbit
apps.localizedDescription: Легкий окремий застосунок для багатокрокових голосових розмов з існуючим Orbit backend.

apps.name: Orbit Mini
apps.subtitle: Hands-free voice remote for Orbit
apps.localizedDescription: A lightweight hands-free voice client for the existing Orbit family assistant. It keeps the same Orbit AI, family memory, profiles, and voice session while you stay in Maps, Safari, or another app.

versions.localizedDescription: Final cleanup build with the proven foreground audio handoff, normal LiveKit session startup, background voice continuation, and external Shortcut return flow.
Voice UX update: quieter conversation banners by default, explicit full-color Orbit sphere loading in Live Activities, state-transition animation identity, and Siri audio-session readiness recovery.

apps.name: Orbit Voice Probe
apps.subtitle: Background microphone capability experiment
apps.localizedDescription: A separate diagnostic probe that tests whether iOS permits microphone buffers to be received after an App Intent launches in the background.

versions.localizedDescription: Fixes the WidgetKit extension metadata so SideStore can preserve the embedded widget without the legacy principal-class restriction.
